title: Elaboration Markdown documents
description: The fixed part of the Markdown documents elaboration hands from agent to agent: the YAML front matter a script reads, and the headings a script resolves. What a document must say is judged by the criteria of effective-architecture/review-standard.md (the architecture documents by the architecture and design level, the TRD by the technical-requirement level, the specs by the specs-and-Tasks level), which this file does not restate. The architecture documents, under `arc42/` and `detailed/` of the architecture root, are of one of two classes: a view (`ArchitectureView`) or a standard or policy (`ArchitectureStandard`). Where each document goes is the architecture documentation model's (`reference/architecture-documentation-model.md` under the architecture root, read through skills/arc42/references/arc42-section-model.md).

Citation.description: One architecture citation: the path of an architecture document (arc42 or detailed) relative to the architecture root, optionally followed by #<heading> as `atw-matrix node document:<path>` lists the heading. Every citation must resolve to a document, and a heading to a heading of it, that the matrix holds.

ArchitectureView.description: The front matter of an architecture view: one way of looking at one subject at one scope, a diagram (Mermaid) and the prose around it, under `arc42/` or `detailed/`. Written by architecture-maintainer through the arc42-author and arc42-maintain skills; read by `atw-matrix sync-documents` (scripts/portfolio/matrixsync.py), which records the document as describing each entry `subject` and `shows` name, and checked by the arc42-verify skill. Classification keys the project uses (`document_class`, `authority`, `provenance`) may stand beside these.

view_type.description: A type from the list of view types, `reference/diagram-and-model-types.md` under the architecture root. A type that names a diagram promises a diagram of that kind in the document.

scope.description: The scope the view describes, as the architecture documentation model names the scopes.

subject.description: The one thing the view describes, named as the glossary or its stack name names it; never a repository, PRD, Epic, bead id or date.

shows.description: Every element the view depicts, by the name the matrix holds for its entry.

purpose.description: One sentence: why the document exists and who acts on it.

ArchitectureStandard.description: The front matter of a standard or a policy under `arc42/` (usually section 8) or `detailed/`: the requirements every element of its scope meets, and how compliance is judged. It is not a view: it carries no diagram, no `view_type`, no `scope` and no `shows`, and it holds requirements only, never an implementation (no construct, library, class or code). Written by architecture-maintainer through the arc42-author and arc42-maintain skills; recorded by `atw-matrix sync-documents` (scripts/portfolio/matrixsync.py) with its headings; checked by the arc42-verify skill.

purpose.description: One sentence: what the standard or policy governs and who applies it.

TrdDocument.description: The front matter of the Epic's TRD (<work>/trd.md), written by trd-author. Each requirement is a heading whose text is exactly its id (for example `#### TR-01`), and under it the members of architecture-result.schema.json#/$defs/TrdRequirement. A matrix constraint that records the requirement points at that heading by the Epic and the id (matrix-kinds.json, `$defs/trdRequirement`); the step `trd.confirm` (orchestrator/flows/trd_authoring.py) fails when a citation does not resolve or a pointer names an id the TRD has no heading for.

decisionIds.description: The architecture documents and headings the TRD's requirements cite.

SpecDocument.description: The front matter of one repository's contracts document (<work>/spec-<slug>.md, written by api-specification-author) and data-model document (<work>/spec-<slug>.data-model.md, written by data-model-specification-author). The step `spec_authoring.story_document` (orchestrator/flows/spec_authoring.py) carries the citations of both onto the Story document and the Story bead.

decisionIds.description: The architecture documents and headings the document cites.
